# Kinds and sizes

The kinds of box bb-box knows, the backends that can offer each, and each kind's sizes as shipped. The configuration's `kinds` section changes the sizes (see the [configuration reference](configuration.md)).

| Kind | What it is | OS | Architecture | Desktop | GPU | Backends |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `linux` | A Linux box for builds, backend services and the agent's own work. | linux | x86_64 | no | no | Proxmox LXC, Proxmox QEMU, SSH host pool, Docker, microsandbox, Hetzner Cloud |
| `linux-desktop` | A Linux desktop on a GPU, for computer use, browsers and app development. | linux | x86_64 | yes | yes | Proxmox LXC, Docker |
| `linux-desktop-cpu` | A Linux desktop drawn by the CPU, for computer use and browsers. | linux | x86_64 | yes | no | Proxmox LXC, Proxmox QEMU, Docker, microsandbox, Hetzner Cloud |
| `linux-desktop-wayland-cpu` | A Linux desktop on Wayland (Sway), drawn by the CPU, for computer use, browsers and apps built for Wayland. X11-only apps do not run there. | linux | x86_64 | yes, Wayland | no | Proxmox LXC, Docker, Hetzner Cloud |
| `linux-arm64` | A Linux box on arm64. amd64 container images and x86_64 binaries do not run there. | linux | arm64 | no | no | Tart, microsandbox |
| `linux-arm64-desktop-cpu` | A Linux desktop on arm64, drawn by the CPU. amd64 container images and x86_64 binaries do not run there. | linux | arm64 | yes | no | Tart, microsandbox |
| `macos` | A Mac for builds and Apple's tools. | macos | arm64 | no | no | SSH host pool, Tart |
| `macos-desktop` | A macOS desktop for computer use and app development. | macos | arm64 | yes | no | SSH host pool, Tart |
| `windows-desktop` | A Windows desktop for computer use, browsers and Windows apps. | windows | x86_64 | yes | no | Proxmox QEMU |
| `windows-arm64-desktop` | A Windows desktop on arm64, for computer use, browsers and Windows apps. x64 apps run under Windows' emulation, more slowly; x64 drivers do not. | windows | arm64 | yes | no | Tart |

## Aliases

An alias asks for a kind with features, from the offers that have them (041).

| Alias | Kind | Features |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `linux-docker` | `linux` | docker |
| `linux-arm64-docker` | `linux-arm64` | docker |
| `linux-vm` | `linux` | kernel |
| `linux-kvm` | `linux` | kvm |

## Sizes

Each kind has the presets small, medium, large, a default preset, and a largest size a custom size may reach. A disk left out is the image's own.

| Kind | small | medium | large | Default | Largest |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `linux` | 2 cores, 4 GiB memory | 4 cores, 8 GiB memory | 8 cores, 16 GiB memory | small | 16 cores, 32 GiB memory, 256 GiB disk |
| `linux-desktop` | 4 cores, 8 GiB memory | 8 cores, 16 GiB memory | 16 cores, 32 GiB memory | small | 32 cores, 64 GiB memory, 256 GiB disk |
| `linux-desktop-cpu` | 4 cores, 8 GiB memory | 8 cores, 16 GiB memory | 16 cores, 32 GiB memory | small | 32 cores, 64 GiB memory, 256 GiB disk |
| `linux-desktop-wayland-cpu` | 4 cores, 8 GiB memory | 8 cores, 16 GiB memory | 16 cores, 32 GiB memory | small | 32 cores, 64 GiB memory, 256 GiB disk |
| `linux-arm64` | 2 cores, 4 GiB memory | 4 cores, 8 GiB memory | 8 cores, 16 GiB memory | small | 16 cores, 32 GiB memory, 256 GiB disk |
| `linux-arm64-desktop-cpu` | 4 cores, 8 GiB memory | 8 cores, 16 GiB memory | 16 cores, 32 GiB memory | small | 32 cores, 64 GiB memory, 256 GiB disk |
| `macos` | 4 cores, 8 GiB memory | 6 cores, 16 GiB memory | 8 cores, 32 GiB memory | small | 16 cores, 64 GiB memory, 256 GiB disk |
| `macos-desktop` | 4 cores, 8 GiB memory | 6 cores, 16 GiB memory | 8 cores, 32 GiB memory | small | 16 cores, 64 GiB memory, 256 GiB disk |
| `windows-desktop` | 4 cores, 8 GiB memory | 8 cores, 16 GiB memory | 16 cores, 32 GiB memory | small | 32 cores, 64 GiB memory, 256 GiB disk |
| `windows-arm64-desktop` | 4 cores, 8 GiB memory | 8 cores, 16 GiB memory | 16 cores, 32 GiB memory | small | 32 cores, 64 GiB memory, 256 GiB disk |
